items.information: Español • “Back To Cubing Chiriquí 2022” será la tercera competencia oficial en Chiriquí. • Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA. English • “Back To Cubing Chiriquí 2022” will be the third official competition in Chiriquí. • With national biosafety protocols and those established by the WCA. items.name: Kubkvarna 2022
items.information: Välkomna till Kubkvarna 2022, en tävling som ännu en gång välkomnar er alla till härliga Folkets Park i Huskvarna. Alla är välkomna att delta, vare sig du löser kuben på 10 minuter eller 6 sekunder. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är **gratis**, mer information finns under fliken SveKub, och på [SveKubs hemsida](https://svekub.se/bli-medlem/). ------ Welcome to Kubkvarna 2022, a competition that once again welcomes you all to the lovely Folket Park in Huskvarna. Everyone is welcome to compete, whether you solve the cube in 10 minutes or 6 seconds. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. Membership is available for everyone with a Swedish personal number, and it is **free**. Read more on the SveKub tab, or on [SveKub's website](https://svekub.se/en/bli-medlem/).

items.information: Lyttelton Autumn 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 30,00 (inscrição+camiseta) para os competidores pagos nos dias da competição durante o credenciamento. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou, uma dose de vacina e teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 1. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$30,00 (registration+shirt) and must be paid on the days of competition during the registration. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (welbertmoutta@hotmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a dose of vaccine and negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue.

items.information: **Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país. Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. **A las personas que estaban inscritas en Costa Rica Regresa (v1) se les solicita hacer el registro lo más rápido posible ** Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años. Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona. Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. **.....................English version...................** Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country. Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. We will only allow one companion per person. Each competitor must bring their own pen. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.
